description: Get your personal MU affiliate (referral) link + stats. Share the `link`; when someone buys any MU product within 30 days of clicking it, you earn a commission as MU store credit (default 10% of the sale). You can also append the returned `ref_param` to any product URL. Returns clicks, sales (uses), earned_jpy and your mu_credit_balance. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`.
name: mu_affiliate
title: Get my MU affiliate link
